Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::modifySupplier(id:Integer,name:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          supplier:Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(s | s.Id = id)
            
            precondition:
          not supplier.oclIsUndefined()
            
            postcondition:
          let isUpdated:Boolean in if not supplier.oclIsUndefined() then supplier.Name = name and isUpdated = true else isUpdated = false endif and result = isUpdated
            
        }
